def ref_exhaustive(req):
    R=m.parse_request(req); F=R['flows']; caps=R['caps']

def gen(rng,nflows,nnodes,capmax,tight=True):
    nodes=['v%02d'%i for i in range(nnodes)]
    caps=dict((n,rng.randint(0,capmax)) for n in nodes)
    flows=[];offers={}
    H=rng.choice([8,9,10,12])
    for i in range(nflows):
        k=rng.randint(2,min(6,nnodes))
        path=rng.sample(nodes,k)
        nd=rng.randint(0,H-5)
        kinds=['D']*nd+['Q','T']+['K']*(H-2-nd)
        rng.shuffle(kinds)
        tmpl=bytes(rng.randint(0,255) for _ in range(H))
        fid='f%02d'%i
        flows.append(dict(id=fid,path=path,template=tmpl.hex(),kinds=''.join(kinds)))
        runs=[]
        for _ in range(rng.randint(0,4)):
            hdr=bytearray(tmpl)
            for j,c in enumerate(kinds):
                if c!='K': hdr[j]=rng.randint(0,255)
            hdr[kinds.index('Q')]=rng.choice([0,3,7,8,200])
            hdr[kinds.index('T')]=rng.choice([0,1,2,k,rng.randint(k,255)])
            if rng.random()<0.2:
                j=rng.choice([x for x,c in enumerate(kinds) if c=='K'])
                hdr[j]=rng.randint(0,255)
            runs.append(dict(header=bytes(hdr).hex(),count=rng.randint(1,5)))
        offers[fid]=runs
    warmup=rng.choice([0,0,1,2,3,7])
    ids=[f['id'] for f in flows]
    pinned=rng.sample(ids,rng.randint(0,min(4,nflows))) if rng.random()<0.5 else []
    return dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=warmup,pinned=pinned,offers=offers)
